content:
We have consolidated dataset with 52 polymorphs from 18 compositions (maybe some missing due to errors). Next steps: prepare tabular dataset with advanced feature engineering, test_split 0.2, normalize True, target property formation_energy_per_atom. Output path maybe something like .../ml_oxides_trial_21/dataset. Then train XGBoost with given hyperparameters, then evaluate on test set (mae, rmse, r2, feature_importance). Then cross-validation (5-fold) on training data to get r2_mean and r2_std. Finally save results JSON to a file and output path.

We need to use prepare_tabular_dataset tool.
